name: Refurbished iPhone online store: launch plan and first-year costs
about: Launching an online store selling refurbished iPhones: sourcing from wholesale refurbishers and consumer trade-ins, grading, diagnostics, certified data erasure, battery and screen replacement at an in-house repair bench, a 12-month warranty, and sales through the own store and marketplaces. The store is an independent reseller, not affiliated with Apple. Four phases: Analysis, Implementation, a 3-month launch period with a bigger launch promotion and higher costs, and operation for months 4-12. Staff: one repair technician, about $3,800 a month. days = the owner's or team's project work in man-days (the editor turns it into labor cost as days x rate); capex = fixed assets bought (equipment, furniture, hardware); opex = operating outlays (rent, wages, stock, platform fees, marketing). Costs only: no revenue, and no ongoing stock reorders, payment fees or shipping costs, since they depend on sales.
